# Kushal Mamillapalli — Data Engineer

> Portfolio of Kushal Mamillapalli, a data engineer at Spotify building production personalization pipelines, backend systems, and applied ML infrastructure. One page, four selected projects, three with public repositories.

## Profile

- [Portfolio](https://kushalmam.github.io/): data pipelines and recommendation systems, from retrieval through to the serving path.
- [Résumé (PDF)](https://kushalmam.github.io/documents/kushal-mamillapalli-resume.pdf): current role, education, and project history.
- [Privacy](https://kushalmam.github.io/privacy/): what this site does and does not collect.

## Projects

- [Rekindle](https://github.com/Techdude01/rekindle): next-review ranking pipeline. Offline NDCG@10 of 0.0104 against a 0.0071 baseline over 29,416 eligible warm test events, evaluated chronologically with models frozen before replay.
- [MarketMind](https://github.com/Techdude01/MarketMind-yHack26): market research workspace that connects a market agent to live signals.
- [AutoCPT](https://github.com/Techdude01/AutoCPT): browser speech transcription resolved into suggested CPT codes. HackNYU 2025 winner.
- [NBAnomaly](https://github.com/Techdude01/NBAnomaly): football player anomaly detection over per-match statistics.
